label.explanation: auth-svc reloaded IDP_API_KEY at version 24 and the previous version was revoked (line 202); the new value is not one the identity provider accepts, so every call gets 401 Unauthorized (lines 217, 226, 232, 242). A 401 is the provider answering correctly, not an outage. account-svc's 502s (lines 218, 239, 248, 260, 268, 279) and edge-proxy's (lines 213, 221, 230, 243, 244, 251, 255, 259, 267, 271, 275, 280) are symptoms. Red herrings: line 216 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path); lines 114, 115 (a single identity provider connection reset that succeeded on retry, minutes before onset); line 195 (a single API client being rate-limited, which is the limiter working as intended).
